items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both passing the set check before either inserts, so both run the handler.
Gap 2 says the dedup key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and is spoofable.
Gap 3 says the refund handler is registered as refund.created while the provider sends charge.refunded, so refunds are not recorded.
No gap depends on several processes or replicas; the concurrency gap concerns jobs within one queue.
